comments.body:
The keyword you are looking for in German in "Mobbing". It's the legal definition of harassment in Switzerland and all companies have an obligation to take measures to combat mobbing and sexual harassment. Important: Mobbying is defined as a sustained and systematic harassment - therefore having a diary or a list of precise events is important. 

Once you have that, it depends how much you want to stick your neck out. The atomic version is to take your complaint list and go to the line manager of your supervisor or to HR. They need to act. However, if this will be in your interest is not always guaranteed. A softer approach is to talk to the "Ombudsperson" that should be present in any of the institutions in the ETH domain. 

There is more help available. Check with [https://www.fachstelle-mobbing.ch/](https://www.fachstelle-mobbing.ch/)
